Players Committee card image of [[Obi-Wan In Radiant VII (Virtual Set 0)]] (original printing), a retired Virtual Modern card (Virtual Set 0).

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/obiwaninradiantvii.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). the PC now serves the Madakor In Radiant VII image under this file name (since 30 December 2024).

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
